Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish 'The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury Festival.
The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

pr.t: Hitler's 9/11 - The Secret War on America
pr.d: A look at Hitler's bold plan during World War Two to send fighter planes into Manhattan skyscrapers for the psychological impact it would cause on the citizens in the United States and the world as a whole.
On April 6, 1862, the Confederate force's surprise attack against the Union in Shiloh, Tenn., results in some of the most brutal fighting of the Civil War.

Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's counter-attack at Shiloh, Tenn., leads to victory; thousands of escaping slaves seek refuge with Union forces advancing into the South; President Abraham Lincoln begins drafting a proclamation addressing slavery and freedom.

The Emancipation Proclamation ends slavery and gives blacks the freedom to fight; on July 4, 1863, the day after Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the Confederates surrender Vicksburg, Miss., to Gen. Grant.

The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia succeeds at splitting the Union Army in two during the Battle of Chickamauga; Gen. William Rosecrans is replaced by Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, who plans an offensive.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbour, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Colourized rare archival film and home movies brings Churchill back to life. Includes moments of drama, alongside playful scenes with Charlie Chaplin and Churchill losing his shorts in his swimming pool.

Colourisation of historic film creates a vivid portrait of the Royal Family from the late 19th century onwards. Includes the earliest film of Queen Victoria, and Edward and Wallis Simpson marrying in exile.
Before the Unabomber, New Yorkers were terrified for 16 years by an attacker who planted bombs across the city. The culprit was an electrician named George Metesky.
The strange story of Michael Malloy shows how some people just won't die when you want them to.

Für diese Weihnachtsfans kann es rund um die Feiertage gar nicht genug Dekoration und Traditionen geben.

Nick reist in die geschichtsträchtige Küstenstadt Hastings, um Mike und seine vier Hunde zu besuchen. Gesundheitliche Probleme haben den einstigen Wanderer ausgebremst und seine Hütte versinkt im Chaos. Kann Nick sein Zuhause wieder bewohnbar machen?

Nick reist nach Kettering, wo ein Ehepaar mit zwei Kindern von seinem eigenen Zuhause überwältigt wird. Ihr Dreifamilienhaus ist überfüllt und chaotisch - so sehr, dass es nicht nur ihr Wohlbefinden, sondern sogar ihre Sicherheit gefährdet.

Nach einer Transplantation kämpft Elektriker Frank mit den strukturellen Mängeln seines Hauses, die ein früherer Auftragnehmer hinterlassen hat. Die Familie Holmes nimmt sich des Projekts an und setzt alles daran, das Haus sicher für Frank zu machen.

Die alleinerziehende Hilary aus San Diego will mit ihrer Tochter in ein Tiny House ziehen. Dabei bekommt sie Unterstützung von ihrer Freundin Diane. Hilary wünscht sich ein schlichtes, aber helles Häuschen mit offenem Grundriss.

James ist Fitness- und Outdoorenthusiast und sucht im Bundesstaat Washington ein Tiny House. Dabei hat er ein 28 Quadratmeter großes Haus im rustikalen Stil vor Augen, das eine kleine Küche, ein Schlafzimmer und genügend Platz bietet.

Mit 40.000 US-Dollar wollen sich Angela und Mac ein winziges Haus außerhalb von Greenville kaufen. Ein wenig Interessenkonflikt gibt es: Während Mac sich etwas Rustikales auf einfachem Fundament vorstellt, wünscht sich Angela eher etwas Mobiles.

Heather möchte sich ein Tiny House im Landhausstil in Steamboat Springs, Colorado, kaufen. Dabei wird sie von ihrer Mutter unterstützt, die das Budget im Blick hält. Dabei hat sie ein modernes und buntes Haus in Aussicht.

Acht Jahre in Kanada sind genug für ein Paar und ihre beiden kleinen Kinder. Sie ziehen in die Heimatstadt des Vaters, Freising. Während Michael seine Kindheitserlebnisse in Bayern an seine Kinder weitergeben möchte, hat Sky andere Vorstellungen.

Ein Szenenwechsel soll einem Paar mehr Ruhe schenken, als sie es in San Diego hatten. Kirsten freut sich auf einen Umzug nach Cabo San Lucas und ein stressfreies Leben. Doch Geldsorgen bei der Haussuche dämpfen die Vorfreude.

Sarah wurde eine Stelle als Schwimmlehrerin in Limerick, Irland, angeboten. Mit ihrem Freund Mark im Gepäck zieht das Paar um. Doch mit einem Budget von 1.400 US-Dollar im Monat kommen die beiden bei der Haussuche in Irland nicht weit.

pr.d: Martin, Lucy and Dion visit a grand five-bedroom period house in Folkestone in Kent, a two-bedroom flat in London's Leytonstone and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Fenton in Stoke-on-Trent.

A house with no floor in Edgbaston in Birmingham, a detached house on several levels in Oldham and a former garage complex ripe for development in Forest Hill in London are all sold under the hammer.
A converted 16th-century chapel in Matlock in Derbyshire, a two-bedroom flat in Whetstone in London and a water-damaged house in Wishaw in Scotland are all sold under the hammer.

A two-bed semi in Meir in Stoke-on-Trent is given a country house look, a flat in London's Willesden Green also gets the wow factor, and a semi in Dudley in the West Midlands loses its 1980s look to be brought into the 21st century.
Terraced houses in Gravesend in Kent and Shipley in Derbyshire are given a new lease of life while former church premises in Harrow Weald in Middlesex are given a new use for the community.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet property developers who have all bought at auction and hope to make a profit on their investments. Today a landscape gardener tackles a terrace in Ilkeston in Derby, two friends take on a four-storey house in Sittingbourne in Kent while another couple of friends' first venture together is a studio flat in South Norwood in London.

pr.d: Arguably Britain's most infamous serial killer, Peter Sutcliffe became known as The Yorkshire Ripper when he began murdering women in Yorkshire during the 1970s.
Greg and Michele Williams were attacked in their home. He died, and she survived. Detectives unpick what really happened.

A frantic graduate student calls 911 to say she just shot her boyfriend, a 29-year-old attorney, in self-defence. Police soon discover that her story doesn't add up and realise they are face-to-face with a remorseless, calculating psychopath.

A concerned mother reports her 24-year-old son missing. He has fallen under the spell of a 47-year-old widowed woman. Detectives soon realise she's a sexual psychopath who has claimed the lives of more than one admirer.

When a 21-year-old mother does not return from night classes and her car is found burned, foul play is suspected immediately by detectives. The web of lies that unfolds is shocking as detectives begin their investigation.
When two young ladies do not return home after a run to the local drive-through, their concerned parents search for them. A fisherman gives police their first clue something evil happened.

After getting an alert on his computer, a man races home to confront two men burgling his home. Then, a woman and her child are defenseless when a strange man enters their home until their 122-pound Great Dane springs into action.

It looks like a Hollywood action film as a crazed female driver speeds through neighbourhoods in an RV, with two dogs sitting on her lap. And then, a woman tosses a bag of newborn dogs into a dumpster, outraging an entire community.

In Florida, a woman shopping for bathing suits bravely chases after a man who harasses her and learns that he's a predator who's been preying on women for years. And then, two good Samaritans intervene when an elderly couple is robbed.
Screaming children hang out the windows of a car headed into the ocean. Two sleeping children are unaware that armed burglars are right next to them.

Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur, breaks. With all the additional features, surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.

Robbies Video auf dem er eine Art Body-Percussion präsentiert, ist sehr beliebt bei den anderen Mitschülern. Doch dann will ein Junge ihn zu einem Wettstreit herausfordern. Robbie lässt sich widerwillig darauf ein.

Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
pr.sub: The Real Woori World; The Collector

pr.d: Tori und Beck entschließen sich dazu, den Samstagabend gemeinsam zu verbringen. Doch da es auf keinen Fall ein Date sein kann, verabreden sie sich zu einem Anti-Date. Beide ziehen sich nicht hübsch an und gehen schlecht essen.

Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet FOREVER! Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library: a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.
pr.sub: Halmoni Learns the Internet; The Library

pr.d: Sikowitz will allen Schülern, die für sieben Tage ihr Handy nicht benutzen und nicht ins Internet gehen, eine Eins geben. Doch er hat einen Plan und spielt Jungs und Mädchen gegeneinander aus. Die Mädchen greifen, dann doch zum Handy.
When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.
pr.sub: I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag

pr.d: Tori will unbedingt, dass Beck endlich auf ein Date gehen kann. Doch dadurch wird ihm klar, wie sehr er Jade eigentlich mag.
Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies, but in the process they become bullies themselves; Alvin befriends a new student, but Theodore learns something surprising about him.
Robbie verkauft Rex an Francis Thornesmith für 2000 Dollar und verlangt zusätzlich dessen Puppe. Doch schon kurz danach vermisst Robbie seinen alten Rex.
The Thunder family splits up for the night. The boys decide to survive 24 hours in the wilderness, while the girls try to bond over some of Barb's favourite farm activities from her childhood.

Andre wohnt bei Tori zusammen, damit sie an einem Song arbeiten können. Doch sie stellen schnell fest, dass sie nicht die besten Mitbewohner sind. Jade entdeckt, dass ein wenig schmeichelhaftes Bild von ihr im Internet gelandet ist.

Max and Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule. However, the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick.

Sikowitz hat sich gedacht, dass es eine gute Idee wäre, wenn alle für einen Tag nur "ja" sagen. Doch leider enden Cat und Robbie dadurch in einer Mülltonne während Trina, Jade und Tori Käsewürfel spielen. Andre, Beck und Sinjin haben auch Vorfälle.
When Ray hears that Piper is going to Junior Anger Management to work on her anger issues, he makes a wager with Henry that he can make her lose her temper before the night ends.

Tori soll für die Quizshow "Brainsqueezers" ein Team zusammenstellen. Ihre Freunde setzen sie deswegen unter Druck. Es dürfen zwar alle teilnehmen, doch das Format entpuppt sich als Horrorshow und alle gehen leer aus.
After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson.

Bei einem großen Sportevent singt Tori die Nationalhymne, wird währenddessen aber unterbrochen und von einem Hund über den Boden geschleift. Danach versucht sie in einer Talkshow, diesen Fehler zu erklären und wiedergutzumachen.
The twins and Marsupilamis' game of golf results in Hope and Punch being caught by Stan. The Twins have Callie for a sleepover and whilst sleepwalking she meets the Marsupilamis.

Mrs. Puff muss SpongeBob zur Aufsichtsperson der Fahrschule ernennen, weil alle anderen schon dran waren, aber SpongeBob nimmt den Job etwas zu ernst, außerdem bereitet SpongeBobs neue Haus-Qualle ihm mit ihren Partys schlechte Laune.

Sandy hat eine Mondrakete, in die sich Patrick und SpongeBob nachts hineinschleichen. Natürlich drücken die Chaoten auf den Startknopf und fliegen los, allerdings landen sie wieder in Bikini Bottom, außerdem hat SpongeBob neue, quietschende Schuhe.

Mr. Krabs' Piratenopa will seinen Enkel besuchen kommen. Allerdings weiß er nicht, dass Mr. Krabs gar kein Pirat mehr ist. Also muss die Krosse Krabbe zum Piratenschiff umgebaut werden. Und: SpongeBob muss Thaddäus aufmuntern.
Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it's very difficult to put out a fire on foot!
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
pr.sub: The Battle of the Sitters; Let's Smurf to Mars

pr.d: SpongeBob möchte unbedingt, dass Thaddäus ihn besucht, der könnte sich allerdings kaum etwas Schlimmeres vorstellen. Mit einem Trick lockt SpongeBob ihn rüber. Und: SpongeBob ist gezwungen, runde Hosen zu kaufen, in denen ihn jedoch niemand erkennt.

Dave sets down a very strict study schedule when Alvin blames him for his poor grades. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidentally shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is watching.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.

Thaddäus ernennt SpongeBob aus Faulheit zum Chef vom Dienst, was allerdings nur 15 Minuten währt, da dann bereits das Chaos ausgebrochen ist. Und: Sandy, Mr. Krabs und Patrick bitten SpongeBob um Gefallen, die er ihnen nicht abschlagen möchte.

SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel between their houses. Patrick wreaks havoc in Bikini Bottom when he learns karate.

When an unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers, SpongeBob and Patrick must help him find his true identity. SpongeBob is sent to time-out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to rectify the situation.

Zum Schluss folgt eine emotionale Achterbahnfahrt. Franzi kommt gestärkt und sichtbar befreit aus ihrer Einzelsession zurück. Am Abend gibt es Post von zu Hause. Dann ist es so weit: Die Moderatorin läutet das große Finale ein.

Nachdem Frida Kahlo 1925 im Alter von 18 Jahren bei einem Busunfall schwer verletzt worden ist, beginnt sie wie besessen zu malen. Mit dem Pinsel therapiert sie im Bett ihre psychischen und physischen Schmerzen. Gerade auf dem Weg der Besserung lernt sie Diego Rivera kennen und bittet ihn, ehrlich ihr Talent einzuschätzen. Er ist begeistert von ihrem Können - und auch von ihrer Schönheit. Bald schon heiraten sie und werden zu einem der aufregendsten Paare des 20. Jahrhunderts.

Emilie und Marc lassen sich mit ihrem Baby in einem Strandhaus nieder, um einen Neuanfang zu wagen. Eines Tages trifft Emilie Vincent, der beschuldigt wird, seine Frau ermordet zu haben, und beschließt, zu ihrem Job als Anwältin zurückzukehren.

Ein inszeniertes Krimievent wird zur bitteren Realität, als der Hauptdarsteller in der Rolle des Detektivs erstochen aufgefunden wird. Um einen drohenden Medienrummel zu verhindern, muss Janie diesen Fall nun so schnell wie möglich lösen.
Der Redaktionsleiter Flo wird von seinen Kollegen entführt, um einen schönen letzten Tag zu haben.

Der Zufall kommt Alfons zu Hilfe: Weil er sich den Knöchel verstaucht hat, kann er vorerst nicht Fallschirmspringen. Doch er hat nicht mit Sabrina gerechnet: Sie überredet Hildegard, mit ihr zusammen doch noch den Sprung zu wagen. Alfons fällt aus allen Wolken, als Hildegard wieder auf der Erde landet. Er ist so überrumpelt, dass er sich unbedacht zu einer entlarvenden Bemerkung hinreißen lässt.

Goran überredet Natascha, Friedrich zum Geburtstag ein Ständchen zu singen. Die übt daraufhin allein in der Natur und wird unbemerkt von André beobachtet. Zu seinem eigenen Erstaunen bemerkt André, dass er plötzlich Gefühle für Natascha entwickelt. Nachdem er ihr auf anonymem Wege ein Geschenk geschickt hat, überlegt Natascha angetan, wer ihr heimlicher Verehrer sein könnte und staunt nicht schlecht, als sich André als dieser zu erkennen gibt.

Die BAU versucht, einen Verdächtigen für einen rituellen Mord ausfindig zu machen. Der Mörder versetzt Tallahassee in Angst und Schrecken. Dabei tötet er die Menschen unter sehr ähnlichen Umständen. Das Team muss den Psychopathen dringend stoppen.

Die BAU untersucht eine gruselige Geistergeschichte über den "Großen Mann". Dann gehen zwei Menschen im Wald verloren. Eine dritte Person taucht am nächsten Tag auf mysteriöse Weise auf, ohne erklären zu können, was passiert ist.

Tarek und Christina erhalten einen Anruf von ihrem guten Freund Carlos, der sein Haus verkaufen möchte. Die beiden wissen natürlich, wie man den Verkaufspreis durch ein paar Arbeiten erhöhen kann, und helfen Carlos bei seinem Projekt.

pr.t: No Demo Reno - Umbau ohne Abriss

Christina widmet sich der Transformation eines chaotischen Hauses, dessen unpraktische Raumaufteilung dem Paar längst zur Last geworden ist. Um das Potenzial des Hauses freizulegen, reißt sie nahezu alle Wände ein und beginnt von Grund auf neu.

Ein Paar, das vor kurzem ein Haus gekauft hat, benötigt Unterstützung bei der Umgestaltung in ein Zuhause für sich und seine drei Kinder. Christina plant eine Erweiterung ihres Hauptwohnraums, aber Probleme könnten die Renovierung verzögern.

pr.d: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

pr.t: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
pr.d: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.

All is revealed in the explosive conclusion. Unprecedented interviews with O.J.'s inner circle expose a drug-smuggling ally who escaped prison shortly before the murders. Jaw-dropping information unveils the identity of O.J.'s alleged co-conspirator.
The chilling crimes of serial killer Colin Pitchfork, who took the lives of two girls in Leicestershire and became the first person to be convicted of rape and murder using DNA profiling.
A wealthy couple and their business partner are brutally murdered in their home in the hills of Las Cruces, New Mexico, and after a year of dead ends, police find the smoking gun.
Police in West Wales respond to a huge fight that unfolds outside a nightclub and target the house of a suspected drug dealer.
The team battle to keep the peace on the streets when two warring gangs come to blows.
An extremely intoxicated woman puts herself and others in danger when she drives her vehicle several metres off the road. A motorcyclist overtaking a car ends up in pain.
A man has an over-the-top reaction when he gets pulled over by the police, and the Yarra Range Highway Patrol sets up a secret sting.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect comes to America to rebuild his life, his career, and his marriage. On his own in a strange new country, he settles in Pennsylvania, where a wealthy and prominent industrialist recognises his talent.

An opera star arrives at a performers' retirement home amidst fraught preparations for a fundraising concert. Her presence adds to the tension, but it also offers an opportunity to reunite a successful quartet.
When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

pr.t: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
pr.d: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.
With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.

A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.

When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.

Life is sweet for Peter Parker, MJ loves him, her career is taking off and Spidey-mania is sweeping New York. However, when an alien parasite bonds to his suit, it's not long before the good times and Spidey turn bad. While his ugly ego is taking centre stage, MJ is dumped from her Broadway show, Harry remembers Spider-Man's role in his father's death, and Peter is consumed by revenge.

A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

Four years after Dr Peter Venkman broke up with Dana Barrett, she appeals for help to save her son when an arch-demon trapped in an oil painting wants to take over his body. The old team reunite and trace the source of the trouble to a sinister underground river of slime.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. She now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, but this time, Laurie's ready for him.

Bei einem Überfall der Latino-Gang "Crazy Aces" wird der Besitzer einer Weinhandlung erschossen. Don Flacks alter Freund und Mentor Sergeant Gavin Moran war als erster am Tatort. Er hat offenbar etwas zu verbergen. Schon bald findet Mac heraus, dass Moran eine Getränkedose vom Tatort mitgenommen hat, um einen der Täter zu decken. Per DNA-Analyse stellen die Ermittler fest, dass sie von Morans Sohn Hector Vásquez stammt.

Ein Taxifahrer wurde brutal zusammengeschlagen und erstochen. Die Vorgehensweise weist auf einen männlichen Täter hin, doch die DNA trägt weibliche Merkmale. Nachdem der Tote als Fernando Reyes identifiziert wurde, führt die Spur zu einem Nachtclub und zu der Tänzerin Jamie Banks, die Reyes in der Mordnacht nach Hause gefahren hatte. Jamie sagt aus, dass sie vor ihrer Haustür von einem Fremden überfallen wurde und Reyes ihr zu Hilfe geeilt war.
